reviewItem.question: For "SwarmMode: In v3, the provider Docker has been split into 2 providers: - Docker provider (without Swarm support) - Swarm provider (Swarm support only) ???", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: In v3 the Docker provider's swarmMode option is unsupported (Swarm moved to a separate Swarm provider), and configuring providers.docker.swarmMode prevents Traefik from starting.
